title: Add available product to shopping cart
text: Available product quantity must be positive and not exceed stock. Add notebook P1 to shopping cart.

title: Add available product to cart
text: Add available product to shopping cart. Available product quantity must be positive and not exceed stock. Add notebook P1 to shopping cart. Registered automation ECOM-001.

title: Remove product from shopping cart
text: Remove a cart product line and clear coupon when the basket becomes empty.

title: Remove product from cart
text: Remove product from shopping cart. Remove a cart product line and clear coupon when the basket becomes empty. Registered automation ECOM-002.

title: Valid coupon discount calculation
text: SAVE10 coupon applies 10 percent discount to eligible cart subtotal, rounded half up. 1000 becomes 900 payable total.

title: Apply valid ten-percent coupon
text: Valid coupon discount calculation. SAVE10 coupon applies 10 percent discount to eligible cart subtotal, rounded half up. 1000 becomes 900 payable total. Registered automation ECOM-003.

title: Invalid coupon validation
text: Unknown coupon code returns 400 Invalid coupon and must not change the payable total.

title: Reject invalid coupon
text: Invalid coupon validation. Unknown coupon code returns 400 Invalid coupon and must not change the payable total. Registered automation ECOM-004.

title: Coupon expiry UTC boundary
text: SAVE10 coupon expiry is exclusive at midnight UTC 2030-01-02; reject expired coupons exactly at expiry.

title: Reject expired coupon
text: Coupon expiry UTC boundary. SAVE10 coupon expiry is exclusive at midnight UTC 2030-01-02; reject expired coupons exactly at expiry. Registered automation ECOM-005.

title: Coupon reuse redemption history
text: Coupon can be redeemed once per customer. Consume redemption on checkout; second use returns 409.

title: Reject coupon reuse
text: Coupon reuse redemption history. Coupon can be redeemed once per customer. Consume redemption on checkout; second use returns 409. Registered automation ECOM-006.

title: Decimal discount rounding
text: Coupon discount calculation for 300 subtotal is 30 discount and 270 payable total; use decimal rounding half up.

title: Verify discount calculation
text: Decimal discount rounding. Coupon discount calculation for 300 subtotal is 30 discount and 270 payable total; use decimal rounding half up. Registered automation ECOM-007.

title: Stock quantity limit
text: Adding cart quantity above inventory stock returns 409 without changing cart; notebook stock is five.

title: Reject quantity above stock
text: Stock quantity limit. Adding cart quantity above inventory stock returns 409 without changing cart; notebook stock is five. Registered automation ECOM-008.

title: Checkout order integration
text: Checkout creates order, decrements product stock, consumes coupon and clears cart.

title: Complete checkout

title: Empty cart checkout rejection
text: Empty shopping cart checkout returns 400 Empty cart with no order created.

title: Reject empty checkout
text: Empty cart checkout rejection. Empty shopping cart checkout returns 400 Empty cart with no order created. Registered automation ECOM-010.
